features.title: Admissions

features.title: Activity Feed

features.title: Billing
features.description: Reusable fee plans, billing runs, parent payment proof workflow, credit notes, and account statements with tax frozen at issue time.

features.title: Student Lifecycle
features.description: Manage withdrawal with retention policies, archives, re-enrollment for returning families, and program promotion to the next classroom.

features.title: Embeddable Enquiry Forms

features.title: White-label Branding

body.faq_description: Common questions about DaycareMate, admissions, operations, billing, and platform setup.

faqs.question: Is DaycareMate only for UAE centres?
faqs.answer: No. DaycareMate is built for early childhood education providers worldwide. Currency, timezone, and tax/VAT are configurable per deployment. The UAE is our primary market, not the geographic limit of the product.

faqs.question: Who is DaycareMate for?
faqs.answer: DaycareMate serves preschools, nurseries, childcare centres, early learning centres, Montessori schools, kindergartens, and playschools. It is designed for centres that need admissions, daily care, family communication, and billing in one platform.

faqs.question: How does magic-link admission onboarding work?
faqs.answer: Admins send a one-shot magic-link invite to a parent's email. Parents complete configurable admission forms at their own pace, including child, guardian, sibling, and document upload steps. Staff review and approve in one click, which creates student records and first invoices.

faqs.question: Can we embed enquiry forms on our existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes. DaycareMate provides embeddable enquiry forms for lead capture on your centre website, plus a hosted register page alternative. Leads land in your admin lead board with consent proof. This is enquiry and lead capture, not a hosted visit booking page.

faqs.question: Can teachers log attendance and activities from mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes. Teacher and family portals are responsive and mobile-ready, with PWA add-to-homescreen support. Teachers can run attendance, log activities, and message families from phones and tablets in the classroom.

faqs.question: Does billing support tax and VAT configuration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each deployment supports configurable currency, timezone, and tax/VAT settings. Tax rates are frozen on each invoice at issue time, with per-line taxable flags and audit-logged billing runs.

faqs.question: Is each centre on its own deployment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each centre runs on a dedicated single-tenant deployment with its own database, private storage, and CDN. This keeps centre data isolated and supports configurable regional settings.

faqs.question: What does white-label mean for DaycareMate?
faqs.answer: White-label means the software runs under your centre's brand, not the vendor's. Your centre name, logo, and favicon appear on your dedicated deployment, and invoice PDFs carry your branding. Parents and staff experience your centre's identity; DaycareMate powers the platform behind the scenes.

faqs.question: Is DaycareMate white-labelled for each centre?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each centre gets a dedicated deployment with your branding: centre name, logo, favicon, and branded invoice and receipt PDFs. Your families experience your centre's identity on a platform built for early childhood operations.

faqs.question: What roles and permissions are supported?
faqs.answer: DaycareMate includes 8-role role-based access control with granular permissions across Admin, Teacher, and Family portals. Staff, classroom, and billing access can be scoped to each centre's needs.

faqs.question: Is AI translation included in DaycareMate?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI translation is included for normal daycare use. Parents and staff can tap Translate on messages, broadcasts, and activity updates in 100+ languages. Preferred language is saved on user profiles for one-tap translate.

faqs.question: How many languages does DaycareMate translation support?
faqs.answer: DaycareMate supports the full ISO 639-1 language list (100+ languages). Twenty popular languages for UAE and international nurseries are listed first; search finds the rest. Learn more at daycaremate.com/ai-translation.

faqs.question: Does the AI enquiry assistant auto-create leads?
faqs.answer: No. The optional AI enquiry assistant captures conversations for admin review. Your team manually converts qualified enquiries to the leads pipeline. Nothing is auto-logged without staff action.

faqs.question: Is the AI enquiry assistant included for all centres?
faqs.answer: The AI enquiry assistant is optional and deployable for subscribing centres. It works alongside embeddable enquiry forms and the leads pipeline. IGENTX can also help implement the AI Customer Service Agent on your centre website.

faqs.question: Can parents view daily activities and message teachers?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Family portal provides a per-child activity feed scoped to authorised parents, plus 1:1 messaging with teachers and admins. Broadcasts cover closures, events, and centre-wide reminders.

faqs.question: How do I get started with DaycareMate?
faqs.answer: Visit daycaremate.com to explore the product and request a demo. For implementation support, custom rollout, or combining DaycareMate with website and AI enquiry solutions, talk to the IGENTX team.
